messages.content: You are the ACE Curator. Convert reflections into crisp playbook operations per tool group. Prefer modifying existing bullets when possible, but keep different concepts separate. Only generalize when the evaluation summary indicates a systemic issue, but otherwise don't overgeneralize bullet points. Generally respect the BFCL evaluation but think about what you would want to tell the model in order for it to improve in the many cases it may face in the future.keep the playbook unchanged on successes unless an existing entry now conflicts with verified behaviour. Functional parity with the checker matters more than superficial differences . Output JSON.

Sample ID: parallel_multiple_157
Tool groups: event_finder, geometry, t_test

Existing playbook:
ACE Playbook Insights
Use these distilled reminders to plan tool usage. Keep tool calls faithful to the functions provided in the BFCL benchmark.

geometry
- delta1: Always use dot notation (geometry.area_triangle) not underscore (geometry_area_triangle) for function names.
- delta2: For multi-item requests, batch all identical function calls in parallel in a single turn, not sequentially.
- delta3: For multi-item requests, invoke ALL requested functions in parallel in one turn. Never omit any function.
- delta4: delta4: In parallel_multiple requests, parse ALL functions across ALL tool groups and invoke together in one turn.

Evaluation summary:
BFCL evaluation FAILED for parallel_multiple_157 (parallel_multiple).
Error type: parallel_function_checker_no_order:wrong_count
Error message: Wrong number of functions.

Tool-call differences:
Turn 0: missing geometry.area_triangle; extra geometry_area_triangle
Turn 1: missing geometry.area_triangle
Turn 2: missing t_test
Turn 3: missing event_finder.find_upcoming

Reflection:
{
  "reasoning": "The model made four critical errors: (1) used underscore notation (geometry_area_triangle) instead of dot notation (geometry.area_triangle), (2) only invoked one function when four distinct functions were requested across three tool groups, (3) failed to batch the two triangle area calculations in parallel, and (4) completely omitted t_test and event_finder.find_upcoming calls.",
  "error_identification": "Turn 0 has wrong function name format and missing three functions. Turns 1–3 show progressive omission of geometry.area_triangle, t_test, and event_finder.find_upcoming. The model output contains only one malformed call instead of four parallel calls.",
  "root_cause_analysis": "The model did not parse the full user request to identify all four required functions across tool groups. It appears to have stopped after the first triangle calculation and used incorrect naming convention, violating both the parallel_multiple requirement (invoke all functions together in one turn) and the geometry namespace rule (dot notation).",
  "correct_approach": "In a single Turn 0, invoke all four functions in parallel using correct dot notation: geometry.area_triangle (base=15, height=20), geometry.area_triangle (base=10, height=30), t_test (dataset1=[12,15,18,20,22,25], dataset2=[14,16,19,21,23,26], significance=0.05), and event_finder.find_upcoming (location='Los Angeles, CA', days=14, category='rock concerts').",
  "key_insight": "For parallel_multiple scenarios, always parse the entire user request upfront to identify all functions across all tool groups, then invoke them together in a single turn using correct namespace notation. Never omit any requested function or defer calls to subsequent turns."
}

Guidance:
- If the evaluation PASSED, many cases you would return an empty operation list. Propose removals or updates when the current playbook conflicts with the verified behaviour as to need to be updated.
- If the evaluation FAILED, add, modify, or remove bullets narrowly targeted to the failure described in the summary/details.
- Keep updates scoped to the triggering context unless the pattern is clearly systemic.
- Keep content under 160 characters. Return an empty list when no update is needed.

Return JSON with keys "reasoning" (<=2 sentences) and "operations".
Each operation must be one of:
  {"type": "ADD", "section": "<tool_group>", "content": "<short bullet>"}
  {"type": "MODIFY", "section": "<tool_group>", "ID": "<existing id>", "content": "<short bullet>"}
  {"type": "REMOVE", "section": "<tool_group>", "ID": "<existing id>"}
